tha-ap549:2.1: kiñci nivesesi → kañci niveseti (bj) | saraṇagamane kiñci → saraṇāgamane keci (sya-all); saraṇāgamane kañci (pts) | kañci → kiñci (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap549:2.3: kiñci → kañci (bj, pts); keci (sya-all) | nivesesi → niveseti (bj)
tha-ap549:4.1: yojesi kiñci → yojeti kañci (bj, sya-all) | chaḷabhiññāsu yojesi kiñci → chalabhiññāsu yojeti kañci (pts)
tha-ap549:5.2: asaṅkheyyampi yojanaṁ → asaṅkheyye pi yojane (bj, sya-all, pts) | yojane → asaṅkheyyamapiyojanaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | yojanaṁ → asaṅkheyyepi yojane sī. syā. pī.) (cck note)
tha-ap549:7.2: nighaṇḍumhi → nighaṇṭumhi (bj); nighaṇḍe ca (sya-all); nighaṇṭe ca (pts)
tha-ap549:8.3: varadaṁ → pavaraṁ (sya-all) | seṭṭhaṁ → varadaṁ seṭṭhaṁ (bj: machasaṁ); pavaraṁ seṭṭhaṁ (bj: syā) | varadaṁ → vadataṁ (cck: sī. pī.); pavaraṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap549:9.4: vimalaṁ ahaṁ byāhataṁ → vimalānahaṁ vyāhaṭaṁ (bj) | vimalaṁ ahaṁ → vimalānahaṁ (sya-all) | vimalaṁ → vimalān (pts) | vimalānahaṁ → vākyānaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | vyāhaṭaṁ → vyāhataṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | ahaṁ → vākyāni, sutvāna vimalānahaṁ (cck: sī. syā. pī.)
tha-ap549:11.2: sabbasattavisārado → sabbasatthavisārado (bj) | sabbasattavisārado nipuṇo → sabbatthāpi visārado nipuṇe (sya-all); sabbasatthavisārado nipuṇe (pts)
tha-ap549:14.1: puthujjano vayo santo → puthujjanova yo satto (sya-all) | vayo santo → va yo satto (pts)
tha-ap549:15.4: tamabbhutaṁ → tadabbhutaṁ (bj, sya-all) | khīyiṁsu tamabbhutaṁ → khīyisu tadabbhutaṁ (pts) | tadabbhutaṁ → tambabhūtaṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap549:16.2: loko → loke (sya-all) | garu → guru (pts) | loko → loke (cck: syā. ka.)
tha-ap549:19.2: pādesiṁ kañcanagghiyaṁ cakkavattī mahārajjaṁ → dibbānubhosahantadā cakkavattimahārajjaṁ (sya-all) | yaṁ → pādesiṁ kañcanagghiyaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | kañcanagghiyaṁ → dibbānubhojahaṁ tadā (cck: syā.); rajjaṁ pādesi kaṁcayaṁ (cck: sī.)
tha-ap549:23.3: nāṭaputtena buddhaseṭṭhamupeccahaṁ → nātaputtena buddhaseṭṭhaṁ upeccahaṁ (bj) | nātaputtena → nāṭaputtena (bj: sīmu)
tha-ap549:26.1: tikkhahāsalahupañño → tikkha hāsu lahupañño (bj) | lahupañño → tikkhahāsalahupañño (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap549:27.3: apāyabhūmiṁ sataṁsahassāni balena → apāyabhumiṁ sataṁ sahassāni phalena (bj) | na gacchi → nāgacchi (sya-all, pts)
tha-ap549:27.4: balena → phalena (sya-all) | sataṁsahassāni balena → satasahassāni phalena (pts)
